b_01KXA9ZXBJQHEH3Z02RPDANSC3.subject: tdec_timing_risk
b_01KXA9ZXBJQHEH3Z02RPDANSC3.content: With 85 days until the 2026-10-05 start and the Addition job-type requiring a minimum 70-day TDEC septic lead, only ~15 days of buffer remain; TDEC contact must be initiated immediately or the start date will slip.
b_01KXA9ZXBJQHEH3Z02RPDANSC3.falsification_test: Confirmation that TDEC has already been contacted, or evidence the existing septic system has sufficient capacity and no permit is needed.

b_01KXA9ZXBJ0E61DVJ1BRRDY56N.subject: subpanel_amperage_check_needed
b_01KXA9ZXBJ0E61DVJ1BRRDY56N.content: The 100-amp subpanel scope triggers a mandatory pre-contract amperage verification on the existing main service per the Addition job-type rules; no such verification is documented in any attached material.
b_01KXA9ZXBJ0E61DVJ1BRRDY56N.falsification_test: A documented amperage check result confirming the main service has adequate capacity.

b_01KXA9ZXBK752CD66X9W8F20AM.subject: long_lead_procurement_status
b_01KXA9ZXBK752CD66X9W8F20AM.content: At minimum three long-lead items are unconfirmed: the LVL beam (21-day lead), four windows (14–21 days), and one exterior door (21–28 days); if the roof is truss-framed, custom trusses add a 28–42 day item — all must be ordered at or before structural sign-off.
b_01KXA9ZXBK752CD66X9W8F20AM.falsification_test: Purchase orders or confirmed delivery dates for each item.

b_01KXA9ZXBKFBYMVN6WCYFW53RQ.subject: concealed_roof_condition_risk
b_01KXA9ZXBKFBYMVN6WCYFW53RQ.content: The 3/12-to-6/12 roof tie-in involves structural conditions hidden above the existing ceiling that cannot be assessed until demo exposes them; a 2–3 day schedule buffer after opening is warranted per Addition job-type rules.
b_01KXA9ZXBKFBYMVN6WCYFW53RQ.falsification_test: A pre-demo structural assessment confirming existing rafters/trusses can accept the new load without modification.
